products.name: Intune Compliance-Failure Diagnostics & Remediation — Commercial
products.short_description: A root-cause method and scripts to read the exact per-setting compliance failure, evaluation timing, grace, and the Conditional Access blast radius — then remediate safely. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Know exactly why a device is non-compliant — before it loses access

A device flips to non-compliant, Conditional Access blocks the user, and the help desk can't say which setting failed or why. This toolkit gives you a root-cause method and scripts to read the exact per-setting failure, understand evaluation timing and grace periods, and see the Conditional Access blast radius — then remediate safely, without disabling policy fleet-wide.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how compliance evaluation works (policy → per-setting state → grace → CA gate), where results surface, and the model behind the diagnostic tree.
  • Requirements Guide — what you need (Intune roles, Graph read access, device access) with how to verify each.
  • Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom tree (which setting failed, evaluation lag, grace expiry, built-in vs custom rule, CA block) with the exact checks per branch.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — compliance-state discovery, per-device per-setting failure validation, a fleet compliance + CA-impact report, safe remediation of common failures, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (setting passes, device compliant, CA allows), plus Best Practices for grace and staged enforcement.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every non-compliant device explained to the exact failing setting — with the Conditional Access impact and a safe fix — using a repeatable method you keep and reuse.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • INTCOMPDX-Discovery.ps1 — enumerate Intune compliance policies, their settings, grace, assignments, and device compliance state (read-only)
    • INTCOMPDX-Remediation.ps1 — apply safe, common fixes for compliance failures with a preview-first (-WhatIf) default
    • INTCOMPDX-Report.ps1 — fleet compliance summary ranked by failing setting, plus Conditional Access impact (read-only)
    • INTCOMPDX-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/adjust pilot or target group membership for staged remediation, preview-first (-WhatIf)
    • INTCOMPDX-Validation.ps1 — read the per-device, per-setting compliance failure with the raw reason (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.

Government / GCC High tenant? A dedicated Government (GCC High) edition of this solution is available — authored for the US sovereign cloud (correct *.us portals, US Gov Graph endpoints, and Commercial-vs-GCC-High feature parity gaps called out).
